service.name: claude-code
gen_ai.provider.name: anthropic
gen_ai.operation.name: execute_tool
gen_ai.tool.name: Bash
full_command:
rm -f /tmp/chk.db && PULSO_DB=/tmp/chk.db PULSO_ADMIN_KEY=k python -c "
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from pulso import reloj
from pulso.main import crear_app
reloj.fijar(datetime(2026,11,10,15,tzinfo=timezone.utc))
c = TestClient(crear_app()); H={'X-Admin-Key':'k'}
r = c.post('/admin/series', json={'nombre':'Yoga','instructor':'Sofía','dia':'martes','hora':'19:00','duracion_min':60,'cupo':15,'desde':'2026-11-10','hasta':'2026-12-31'}, headers=H)
print(r.status_code); import json; print(json.dumps(r.json(), ensure_ascii=False)[:600])
print(len(r.json()['clases']))
r2 = c.patch(f\"/admin/series/{r.json()['id']}\", json={'desde_clase_id': r.json()['clases'][1]['id'], 'hora':'20:00','instructor':'Leo'}, headers=H)
print(r2.status_code, r2.json()['clases'][1]['inicio'], r2.json()['clases'][0]['inicio'])
print(c.patch(f\"/admin/series/{r.json()['id']}\", json={'desde_clase_id': r.json()['clases'][1]['id'], 'hora':'08:00'}, headers=H).json())
"; rm -f /tmp/chk.db
